responsibility: This header declares the libfunc side of the optabs subsystem: lookup of optab and conversion libcalls, libfunc name generation helpers for integer/floating/fixed-point operations, creation of libfunc declarations and symbol refs, reassignment of assembler names, mutation of optab-to-libfunc mappings, and initialization of normal and sync libfunc tables for the current target.
same_name_distinction: Declaration header in the `optabs-libfuncs` group: it exposes the libfunc lookup, generation, and initialization APIs, whereas `gcc/optabs-libfuncs.cc` provides the mapping and setup implementation.
